name: Qoder CLI
description: Native qodercli browser-account or personal-access-token authentication. Account models are discovered by the CLI; text chat only, no server-side tools. SSE is buffered until native completion.
author: MyAIrouter

fields.label: Qoder Browser Account
fields.description: Opaque native account bundle from browser login. Choose either browser account or PAT, not both.

fields.label: Qoder Personal Access Token
fields.description: Qoder PAT consumed by native qodercli. Legacy api_key credentials are accepted only as a PAT alias.

fields.label: Qoder CLI Executable (Optional)
fields.description: Administrator-owned qodercli executable path; defaults to qodercli on the service PATH.
